subject.title: fix(whatsapp): bound Signal sessions per bundle

question: Should Crabline permit a fixed no-eviction sender-session quota, or require bounded retention that still allows legitimate new contacts over the provider server’s lifetime?
rationale: The correct balance between resource-exhaustion protection and provider-compatible session turnover is a protocol and security-boundary choice that cannot safely be inferred from the current tests.

options.title: Require safe session turnover
options.body: Replace the permanent 32-session quota with a provider-realistic ceiling and expiry or eviction restricted to genuinely inactive sessions.

options.title: Approve the fixed mock quota
options.body: Keep a hard no-eviction quota only if maintainers explicitly accept the compatibility limitation and choose a defensible capacity.

recommendation.title: Require safe session turnover
recommendation.body: Replace the permanent 32-session quota with a provider-realistic ceiling and expiry or eviction restricted to genuinely inactive sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Their available feature-history connection to the foundational WhatsApp integration makes them the best routing candidate for this protocol choice.
